title: SoniCraft PAL Resourcepack
description: Change your Sega Genesis to European Sega Mega Drive
body:
***NOTICE: for correctly work SoniCraft PAL ResourcePack requires mod SoniCraft (perfectly latest version, for Forge MC 1.18.2) and GeckoLib mod-core.***

There is my first ResourcePack for mod SoniCraft by EnderPreston. This ResourcePack change from US Genesis console to EU Mega Drive. Cartridges also gots your own textures, and if you put cartridges to your Mega Drive then the title screen sounds will also sound like in real life (i.e. at 50Hz)

If you like my ResourcePack then I can make a version with JP Mega Drive and cartridges, enjoy ^_^
